name: Invention Engineer
tagline: Turns the gear you own into a workable hardware build plan
description: Describe the equipment and skills already on hand and it fills the rest of the project: a researched design, a parts list, where to buy each item, and ordered assembly instructions. It stops at planning, so nothing is bought or fabricated for you and every purchase stays your call.
author: Wardonis
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
